Fixed and redeployed at **http://maker:4000/**.

Cause: the partial-update validator was incorrectly applying new-bookmark defaults to omitted fields. A read-later or favorite toggle therefore supplied an empty note and tag list.

State-only changes now preserve:

- Title and URL
- Formatted note
- All tags
- Favorite/read-later state not being changed
- Archive and saved media data

Regression coverage now checks read-later, favorite, read/unread, and archive toggles at both API and browser levels.

Validation:

- 53 automated tests passed
- 5 Chromium journeys passed
- Direct runtime checks confirmed the note, tags, and title survive both toggles
- Review data was reset to a clean state

The fix is in [bookmark.ts](/work/shared/src/schemas/bookmark.ts), with regression coverage in [read-later.test.ts](/work/server/tests/contract/read-later.test.ts).
